messages:
Alice (docs): Hey team — opening a thread to coordinate a docs PR that clarifies proxy-chaining + KMS/HSM workflows for on-prem / semi-airgap installs. Customers are confused about how to chain an outbound egress proxy, a local sidecar, and a KMS/HSM behind the same network path.
Ben (eng-runtime): +1. Saw a support case where the KMS token handshake kept timing out because the proxy stripped SNI. Need concrete examples and a troubleshooting checklist.
Carla (eng-security): We should call out mTLS client cert flow for KMS and PKCS#11 socket permissions. Also mention HSM vendor quirks (lib path, ownership).
Alice (docs): Draft checklist I propose to include in PR: 1) verify NO_PROXY includes HSM IPs 2) systemd unit env for proxy 3) curl mTLS healthcheck example 4) nftables/iptables hairpin note 5) how to surface PKCS11 errors in logs.
Samir (installer): I'll verify installer behavior for proxies. For semi-airgap installs the installer sets HTTPS_PROXY only for the bootstrap node, we should show how to propagate to the runtime sidecars.
Alice (docs): Example snippets to land in the doc (feel free to tweak):

```
# systemd unit fragment for runtime that needs KMS access
[Service]
Environment=HTTPS_PROXY=https://egress-proxy.corp:3128
Environment=NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,10.0.0.0/8,10.1.2.3  # add HSM/KMS IPs
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redwood-runtime --config /etc/redwood/config.yaml
```

and a quick mTLS curl check:

```
curl --cert ./client.crt --key ./client.key --cacert ./ca.pem \ 
  https://kms.local.internal:7443/v1/health
# expect 200 and JSON {"status":"ok"}
```

Alice (docs): Also propose adding this PKCS11 note: "Ensure the PKCS11 module path (e.g. /usr/lib64/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so) is readable by the runtime user and that the tpm/hsm socket permissions allow the runtime service to connect; otherwise look for permission denied in journalctl -u redwood-runtime."

Carla (eng-security): Add explicit example for PKCS11 env override in config: `PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/your-lib.so` + note about SELinux contexts. Without SELinux policy, relabel the module and socket.
Ben (eng-runtime): For proxy chaining pitfalls, call out these gotchas: 1) proxy rewriting of Host/SNI; 2) intercepting TLS (corporate MITM) breaks client cert auth; 3) hairpin NAT causing connections to resolve to public VIPs. I can add a short troubleshooting flow with expected curl error strings.
Ben (eng-runtime): Quick ascii diag to include in doc (or link to figma):

[client] -> [local-sidecar proxy] -> [egress proxy] -> [kms/hsm cluster]

Ben (eng-runtime): Figma with full diagram: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/proxy-chaining-diagram (can be embedded in the docs).

Samir (installer): Test steps I'll run and include: 1) bootstrap with mirrored packages 2) set HTTPS_PROXY on bootstrap node 3) run `./tools/conn-checker --target kms.local:7443` 4) collect `journalctl -u redwood-runtime` + `strace -f` if PKCS11 socket fails. I'll paste logs to the PR.
Alice (docs): Great — I'm opening the PR now with the snippets above and a short step-by-step migration section for customers moving from direct KMS to proxied KMS. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 (draft).
Carla (eng-security): I'll review specifically for SELinux + HSM vendor notes. If we reference vendor libs, let's add a non-exhaustive list and link to vendor docs instead of copying content.
Ben (eng-runtime): Suggest adding a small automated smoke test that runs the curl mTLS check during docs CI (renders as a command block). Could help catch doc drift.
Deploy-bot: CI: docs/lint ✓, linkcheck running (0/102) :gear:
Alice (docs): Thanks — requested reviews from @Ben and @Carla on the PR. Plan: land the doc once CI/linkcheck green and Samir has pasted a real-world log example.
Carla (eng-security): Fyi add note: if corp proxy performs TLS interception, the runtime must trust the interception CA and client cert auth will only work if the proxy passes through the auth headers. We'll add a short 'when proxy does TLS interception' subsection.
Samir (installer): Quick heads-up — I found one edge-case where nftables DNAT + hairpin requires `sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.route_localnet=1`. I'll add the exact nft rules to the PR.
Alice (docs): Perfect — I'll incorporate the nftables snippet and the sysctl note. Target timeline: non-blocking edits today, reviews by EOD, land tomorrow morning if all green. :thumbsup:
Ben (eng-runtime): Will follow up with small failing-curl log samples to include.
Alice (docs): Thanks everyone — leaving this thread open for any late items.
